PPT REMOTE: READ ME FIRST
=========================

This lets your Garmin Venu Sq 2 Music watch change your PowerPoint slides.
You need TWO things: this app (on your PC) and the watch app (on your watch).

STEP 1: START THIS APP
  1. Make sure Bluetooth is ON in Windows (Settings > Bluetooth & devices).
  2. Double-click  PptRemoteServer.exe  (in this folder).
  3. If a blue window says "Windows protected your PC":
       click "More info", then click "Run anyway".
     (This appears because the app is new and not sold through a store.
      It is safe to continue if you downloaded it from the project's page.)
  4. A window opens. Wait for the top bar to say "Waiting for your watch".

STEP 2: NOTE YOUR PIN
  The window shows a "WATCH PIN" (a few digits).
  You will type it into the watch once.

STEP 3: PUT THE WATCH APP ON YOUR WATCH
  Download  PptRemote.prg  from the same place you got this zip, then
  follow the picture-free guide on the project website, or:
    - Plug the watch into your PC with its USB cable.
    - Open File Explorer, open the watch, then the folder  GARMIN  and then  Apps.
    - Copy  PptRemote.prg  into  Apps.
    - Unplug the watch.

STEP 4: USE IT
  - On the watch, open "PPT Remote" and type the PIN from Step 2.
  - The top bar on the PC turns GREEN and says "Watch connected".
  - Start your slideshow, then tap NEXT / PREV on the watch.

TIPS
  - Closing the window does NOT quit the app. It hides in the tray (bottom-right
    of the screen, near the clock; you may need to click the little ^ arrow).
    Right-click the tray icon and choose Quit to close it for real.
  - The slideshow must be the window you are looking at (the "active" window).
  - Forgot the PIN? It is shown in the window. Click "Show".

Nothing is sent over the internet. Everything stays between your watch and your PC.
